instructions: Extract only seizure assertions and supported relationships involving them. Use only the supplied letters. Do not call tools, read files or use prior conversations. Return only JSON matching annotation_schema. Evidence quotations must occur in the supplied letter. Preserve unknown dates without inventing bounds. Current use is not a medication start; a planned investigation is not a result. Leave unsupported identity unresolved.

documents.text:
Epilepsy clinic letter
Consultation: 15 February 2025
Patient: Fatima Patel, aged 24

Dear colleague,

Fatima attended clinic with her partner. She has a known diagnosis of focal epilepsy.

There is a striking discrepancy in the history provided today. Her partner reports that Fatima experiences recurring nocturnal seizures roughly two to three times a week, during which she exhibits tonic stiffening followed by stertorous breathing. The partner states the most recent nocturnal seizure was on 12 February 2025. Fatima herself has total amnesia for these episodes, firmly denies that any nocturnal events occur, and insists she is entirely seizure-free and feels perfectly well. Because of this direct informant discordance, I have recorded both accounts separately. She continues lamotrigine 100 mg twice daily.

We agreed to maintain her lamotrigine dose while her partner attempts home video recording. No EEG requested. Review in four months.

Epilepsy clinic letter
Consultation: 25 June 2025
Patient: Fatima Patel

Dear colleague,

I reviewed Fatima and her partner today. Her diagnosis remains focal epilepsy.

Her partner captured a clear home video on 10 June 2025 showing nocturnal hypermotor tonic activity lasting 45 seconds. Having viewed the video, Fatima now acknowledges that nocturnal seizures are indeed taking place despite her lack of subjective awareness. The partner reports similar nocturnal seizures continued weekly until mid-June.

In light of this verified active seizure frequency, we agreed to increase lamotrigine to 150 mg twice daily. No EEG requested. Review in three months.

Epilepsy clinic letter
Consultation: 30 September 2025
Patient: Fatima Patel

Dear colleague,

Fatima and her partner attended for follow-up. Fatima tolerated the increase of lamotrigine to 150 mg twice daily well. Both Fatima and her partner confirm complete cessation of nocturnal seizures since early August 2025, with no further episodes.

We agreed to continue current dosing. Routine review in six months.

assertions.description: Statements preserved separately from each supplied letter.

links.description: Supported relationships; leave uncertain identity unresolved.

DateBounds.description: Bounds on one endpoint, not an interval between two events.

Time.description: Time supported by the text. An uncertain endpoint has bounds; an unstated endpoint is null.

anyOf.description: Source time expression; null when not stated.

kind.description: What the time describes. Result availability refers to the clinical team.

anyOf.description: Letter whose visit date anchors a relative or implicit current time; null if no anchor is needed.

Span.description: Exact evidence in an unchanged letter.

start.description: Zero-based character position of the first quoted character.

end.description: Character position immediately after the quote.

text.description: Exact quote, including punctuation and spaces.

Quantity.description: Inclusive numerical bounds. Null bounds preserve unspecified amounts; do not invent a midpoint.

anyOf.description: Lowest supported amount; null when unspecified.
Highest supported amount; null when unspecified.

lower_inclusive.description: False for a strict lower bound; omitted means inclusive.

upper_inclusive.description: False for a strict upper bound; omitted means inclusive.

Period.description: Time basis of a reported rate.

unit.description: Time unit as documented; do not convert months to days.

Burden.description: Preserve counts, time basis, ranges and cluster structure separately. For freedom, period is the stated duration.

kind.description: Rate, interval count, clusters, seizure-free duration, or words without a recoverable number.

approximate.description: True when the source qualifies the amount as approximate.

Diagnosis.description: An epilepsy diagnosis assertion; a seizure description is not a diagnosis.

name.description: Documented epilepsy diagnosis, preserving unspecified type.

phase.description: Whether the diagnosis applies now or is described as past.

Seizure.description: Seizure-related information, including explicitly non-epileptic events.

names.description: One name per pattern; several only for an explicit inventory.

kind.description: A dated event, recurring pattern, explicit absence, or stated complete/incomplete list.

interpretation.description: Interpretation asserted in this letter, not the latest interpretation elsewhere.

scope.description: Whether the assertion concerns a named pattern, all epileptic events, or all reported event types.

Medication.description: A medication statement; silence does not establish non-use.

status.description: Keep a plan or prescription separate from reported use.

anyOf.description: Condition stated for a conditional action.

Investigation.description: An investigation assertion; identical modalities need not identify the same test.

modality.description: Named test modality such as EEG or MRI.

status.description: Keep request, performance and result separate; inventory describes all requests in an interval.

anyOf.description: Reported result, without inferring a diagnosis.
Count only for an explicitly enumerated request inventory.

Assertion.description: One attributable assertion about one clinical fact and time. Split changing statuses into separate assertions.

assertion_id.description: Unique ID for this statement. Preserve an earlier ID when later text disagrees.

letter_id.description: ID of the letter making the statement.

evidence.description: Quotes supporting this statement, its scope and qualifications.

reporter.description: Whose assertion is recorded; mixed only when agreement is explicitly reported.

certainty.description: Certainty expressed in the text, not confidence in the extraction.

polarity.description: Whether the statement is asserted or denied. Do not negate a not_started status twice.

coverage.description: Complete only when the text explicitly exhausts the named scope and interval.

all_prior_history_evidence.description: Quotes explicitly establishing that this assertion covers the entire earlier patient history through its stated end date. Omit or leave empty when the earlier history is unknown. An unknown start date alone does not establish this scope.

Link.description: A supported relationship. Keep both endpoint assertions; do not overwrite either one.

relation.description: How the assertions relate. A correction requires explicit reinterpretation of the same event.

certainty.description: Whether identity and relationship are supported or remain unresolved.

evidence.description: Text supporting identity and the relationship, not merely the existence of both assertions.

first_reinterpretation_evidence.description: Quotes explicitly stating that this was the first change from epileptic to non-epileptic interpretation anywhere in this patient’s history. Only for corrects_interpretation. Omit or leave empty when unknown or limited to one pattern.
